title: Compiler hyperoptimization program (standing, heavy models only)
objective: OWNER DIRECTIVE (verbatim): 'allocate agents/subagents for heavy/more intelligent models (fable, astra, etc.) solely dedicated to compiler optimization. we want to hyper-optimize the compiler.' Run one or more standing engine-engineer lanes on the heaviest model available on your plan (Fable / Opus max effort; Astra-class hosted models if a funded route exists) whose ONLY job is engine performance. Program: (1) reproducible benchmark harness in-repo (crates/perf-bench or extend docs/evidence/perf-2026-09-13 tools): cold full compile and warm single-keystroke for HW1, HW2, the 9 real-world fixtures, a 500KB and a 2MB synthetic document, TikZ-heavy and math-heavy fixtures; reports p50/p95 wall and per-phase (expansion, parse, layout, math, pagination, export) with flamegraphs (cargo-flamegraph/samply); CI job publishing numbers as evidence; regressions >5% fail. (2) Targets: warm keystroke < 2 ms at 500KB and < 10 ms at 2MB end-to-end in the compiler; cold HW1 < 10 ms; PDF export < 10 ms for HW1; memory steady-state < 100 MB at 2MB. (3) Techniques in priority order: incremental re-expansion/re-parse by byte range with stable node ids; paragraph-level layout reuse keyed by content hash (already partially in render-pipeline — make the compiler's own layout do the same); page-level reuse with break-point checkpoints; arena/bump allocation for AST and boxes; interning of control-sequence names and font ids; zero-copy output (write display-list/JSON straight into the reply buffer; avoid Value trees); SIMD/branchless hot loops in the lexer and Liang hyphenation; font metric caches keyed by (font,size); parallel page layout only where TeX semantics allow (independent chapters/floats). (4) Byte-identical output is a hard gate (render-pipeline incremental digests + compiler pinned fixtures) — every optimization ships with proof. Report weekly-style checkpoints on issue #2 with before/after tables; land through the batching agreement (your integration branches).
acceptance: harness merged with CI evidence job
each landed optimization: before/after numbers + byte-identical proof
targets above met or a measured explanation of what blocks them
notes: Standing program; model policy: heaviest available (Fable/Opus max), per the owner. Claim before starting; report on issue #2 with numbers.
